correctness.rationale: Barycentric orbit-conflict lemma gives an actual PL homeomorphism for graph independence complexes under cyclic action, not a character calculation. Pure rotation r^a has orbit quotient C_gcd(n,a) square K2 for d>=2, with d=1 excluded by internal edges. For r^a t, odd orbit length entails a forbidden rung, and even orbit length produces exactly a twisted M_(2d) seam, including d=1 (K2) and d=2 (K4). Reflective generators reduce by column-orbit incidence to open ladders with widths m, m+1, m-2, m-1 or m by odd/even axis and layer toggle; one can check each endpoint pair directly. Open ladder Ind(L_k) folds twice to K2 join Ind(L_(k-2)) and is S^(ceil(k/2)-1) including k=1,2. For the circular and Möbius ordinary types the precise cited main results of Agarwal--Basak arXiv:2608.30601v2 (Theorems 12 and 15) are necessary inputs. Independently constructed orbit-conflict graphs for all 272 elements (widths 5..12) and used an independent exact graph-isomorphism test against asserted quotient types; no infinite theorem was inferred from finite checks.
